ERI.note: Document states no startup law, strategy or public fund.

facts.fact: The Eritrea Ministry of Information's Shabait says the NUEYS Youth Innovation and Entrepreneurship Hub, established in 2023, runs a three-level training programme of six months per level in electronics, Python, Scratch, robotics and soldering for mainly Grade 9-11 students.

systems.owner: National Union of Eritrean Youth and Students
